spec: All strings are ASCII. '|' in ADR-RNG 4.1 means plain byte concatenation (no separator).

String values: non-empty, chars [a-z0-9_-] only ('-' added to ADR-RNG's set because rules_version contains it). Ints: decimal, no '+', no leading zeros. Bool/float/null/empty string are invalid. Arrays: elements joined by ',', order preserved, empty array -> empty value, elements are ints or strings, no nesting.
canon_request: flatten nested dicts with prefix 'parent.', lines 'key=value\n', sorted by key as bytes (so 'args.node_id' sorts between 'a' and 'attempt'). Keys are [a-z0-9_]+.

canon_action (log line): 'fn|p0=v0|p1=v1...\n'. fn is [a-z_]+. The in-game log is positional, so parameters are named p0..p9 by position (max 10), in positional order. canon_delta = lines concatenated in the order they happened; empty delta = empty string.
h_0 = SHA256('axiedice/log/v1' || run_id). h_n = SHA256('axiedice/log/v1' || h_{n-1} (32 raw bytes) || canon_delta_n). In requests, h is lowercase hex (64 chars).
commit = SHA256('axiedice/commit/v1' || run_id || S_run (32 raw bytes)).

seed = first 4 bytes of HMAC-SHA256(key = S_run (32 raw bytes), msg = canon_request(request)), big-endian, as unsigned 32-bit int. request = {run_id, seq, kind, args{...}, h, log_len, rules_version, attempt, client_nonce}; attempt is an int (0 unless kind == continue); client_nonce lowercase hex.

node_id format: r<row>_c<col> (row >= 1, col >= 0, decimal, no leading zeros), e.g. r1_c0, r12_c3. The row is the integer after the leading r. DO derives the row from it to refuse row-skipping (M7). Any other node_id is invalid for kinds node/shop_roll/shop_refresh/continue/pact_reroll/reward. A rules_version containing '-' is fine: '-' is allowed in string values; '.' is not.
aid_use line (client rebuilds it from (aid_id, args)): canon_action({fn:'aid_use', args:[aid_id, ...positional args]}).
